details:
Q1. What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase in this repo (for example: clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate, validate) (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script, workflow file, or document — please name the exact file/path
C. A specific bug or failure mode — please describe the current bad behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug / incorrect behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / reduce flakiness
C. Improve performance / speed
D. Improve documentation / readability
E. Improve developer ergonomics / maintainability
Q3. How should success be judged?
Choices:
A. A specific failing scenario should start working — please describe the scenario (RECOMMENDED)
B. A workflow/job/log message should change in a specific way — please describe the expected result
C. A file or document should be updated with specific content — please name it and describe the required change
